messages.author: 3a775dfa0a96bf95
messages.subject: Cumulative distribution plot (ecdf)?
parts:
Is there a geom_ for displaying empirical cumulative distribution functions?

Obviously this can be calculated:

> t <- rnorm(1000)
> ts <- sort(t)
> ggplot(data.frame(x=ts,y=(1:length(ts))/length(ts))) + geom_line(aes(x=x,y=y))

but I was wondering if there's some magic along the lines of:

> t <- rnorm(1000)
> ggplot(data.frame(x=t)) + geom_cdf(aes(x=x))

Thanks,

          -s

I see that as of last July, Hadley planned to write such a thing, but hadn't done it yet (http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/msg/6925d2b2ee238d66).  Has anyone else?
